subject: design/session-log-retirement
statement: Sessions create durable records only for decisions, constraints, or lessons that change future work. Optional operational logs create no memory coverage obligation and are excluded from ordinary retrieval.
intent: Remove mandatory session bookkeeping in this repository and newly installed operands while retaining substantive historical evidence.
rationale: The operator approved removing mandatory session logs, automatic log imports, empty legacy copies, and the three bookkeeping files in PR 1170. The one-time deletion exception binds exact empty Document envelopes and matching bodies, requires an unchanged base and no references, and preserves the ordinary checks for all other records.
fit_criterion: Real Git regressions prove optional-log reconciliation and historical retrieval, a v1 baseline replays before retirement, exact approved empty pairs can be removed, and unapproved memory/source deletion still fails. A built-binary installer regression proves fresh operands neither create nor require session logs and ignore optional logs in Git.

provenance.note: Operator approved the complete session-log cleanup in this session.
